The regions table of the caller

Source: R/features.R
region_set.Rd

Arms (arm_table()), whole chromosomes (first to last bin), tiles of params$tile_sizes (one per window_ids() window, named by tile_name(), end = min(start + size, chromosome end)) and named events, on the chromosomes that have usable bins (chrY only for males). Regions without a usable bin are dropped. Columns follow vignette("scphasedcn-outputs", package = "scphasedcn"): n_bins / n_use count all / usable bins under the containment rule; tiles are eligible when n_bins >= 0.9 * size / bin width and n_use >= 0.7 * n_bins (the eligibility rule of the spike-in calibration), other regions when they have a usable bin; null_region = arm, chrom and tile regions on autosomes not in null_exclude (chromosome or region names); allelic_ok is FALSE on male chrX / chrY; sd_class by sd_class_of().

Usage

region_set(
  bins,
  centromeres,
  classes = c("arm", "chrom", "5Mb", "10Mb", "20Mb", "50Mb"),
  events = NULL,
  sex = "female",
  null_exclude = character(),
  use = NULL,
  params = caller_defaults()
)

Arguments

bins

bins table (chrom, start, end)

centromeres

Battenberg centromere table or path (arm_table())

classes

region classes to build (arm, chrom, tile labels); event is added when events is given

events

NULL, a data.table region, chrom, start, end (NA end = chromosome end), cli_events() output or a named vector of region strings

sex

"female" or "male"

null_exclude

chromosomes (or region names) whose regions never contribute null rows

use

logical bin filter (NULL = all bins)

params

caller_defaults()

Value

regions data.table (passes check_regions())
